_comment: sim-robust-couple-fine-dock-v1: opt-in cross-track terminal docking for the couple fine-dock. Merge the fine_dock block into the mission runtime config. The ONLY change vs the shipped block is approach_mode + the ct_* gains; dropping approach_mode (or setting it to 'hitch_jacobian') restores the legacy law byte-for-byte. See docs/restock_navigation.md 'Couple fine-dock' and data/sim-robust-couple-fine-dock-v1/report.md.
_why: The legacy inverse-hitch-Jacobian creep has a degenerate zero-command equilibrium LINE (lat = gain_yaw*|hitch_x|/gain_lin * yaw_err): ω cancels (lateral vs yaw) with NEITHER hitch nor yaw seated. The couple approach lands on it at whatever yaw the standoff cross-track implies; coldlivefinal (real live_pose collect) landed at ~4.8 deg yaw / ~26 mm hitch -- just outside the 4 deg / 20 mm latch box -- and the creep limit-cycled for the whole 30 s cap. The still-arm coldhonest landed at ~2.7 deg (inside) and latched. 'crosstrack' servos the REAR HITCH (the leading point of the reverse approach, so minimum-phase/stable) onto the cart axis, holding back until aligned then seating straight in -- the only equilibrium is the seated pose.
